chunks: Whatever is in this book from ʿĀʾidh al-Aḥmasī, I have narrated it from my father; and from Muḥammad ibn al-Ḥasan—may Allah be pleased with them both—from Saʿd ibn ʿAbd Allah; and al-Ḥimyarī together, from Aḥmad ibn Muḥammad ibn ʿĪsā, from al-Ḥusayn ibn Saʿīd, from Fuḍālah ibn Ayyūb, from Jamīl, from ʿĀʾidh ibn Ḥabīb al-Aḥmasī.

key_terms.جَمِيعًا: Together; indicating joint transmission from the named authorities.
key_terms.رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُمَا: A supplicatory honorific meaning: may Allah be pleased with them both.
key_terms.رَوَيْتُهُ: I transmitted it; a technical term of narration in hadith transmission.

ai.seo_question: What is the transmission chain to ʿĀʾidh al-Aḥmasī in Man Lā Yaḥḍuruhu al-Faqīh?
ai.summary: This passage records the sanad/isnad through which the author transmits narrations from ʿĀʾidh al-Aḥmasī in Man Lā Yaḥḍuruhu al-Faqīh. Its significance is bibliographical and related to hadith transmission, identifying the chain of authorities through whom these reports were received.
